editorial:
Imagine you are just walking home from school and you stumble upon a wallet stuffed with cash. That is exactly how things start for the main character in this quiet but powerful drama. You will quickly get to know her and her small circle of friends as they deal with the guilt and temptation of finding a lot of money. The movie has a very soft, realistic vibe that makes you feel like you are right there in their small town. It is less about big explosions and more about how one small choice can change your whole life and your relationships with the people you trust most.

What really works here is the acting, as the teens feel like real people instead of movie characters. The story moves a bit slow at first, but the way the tension builds as they try to find the owner is great. If you like stories about growing up and making hard choices, you will love this.
endingExplained: After a lot of stress and lying, the girl finally tracks down the owner of the wallet. You find out that the money was actually meant for something desperate and important. Instead of a happy ending where everyone is rich, the movie ends with a lesson about honesty. The friends have to face the consequences of their secrets, and the girl feels a sense of peace after doing the right thing and returning the cash.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves coming-of-age stories and realistic dramas.
